```{r}
gaussian_sizeweight <- function(w, species_params, w_opt, sigma, ...) {
  exp(-0.5 * ((log(w) - log(w_opt)) / sigma)^2)
}
```

Function to randomize interaction matrix while preserving basic ecological constraints
```{r}
# Function to randomize interaction matrix while preserving basic ecological constraints
randomize_interaction_matrix <- function(params, sdev = 0.1) {
  
  # Get current interaction matrix
  old_inter <- params@interaction
  
  # Get seal catchability only (not all gears)
  seal_idx  <- which(gear_params(params)$gear == "Seals")
  old_seal  <- gear_params(params)$catchability[seal_idx]
  
  # Create noise matrix with same dimensions as interaction matrix
  n          <- nrow(old_inter)
  noise      <- matrix(rnorm(n * n, mean = 0, sd = sdev), nrow = n)
  noise_seal <- rnorm(length(seal_idx), mean = 0, sd = sdev)
  
  # Add lognormal noise
  new_inter <- old_inter * exp(noise)
  new_seal  <- old_seal  * exp(noise_seal)
  
  # Clip to [0, 1]
  new_inter <- pmin(pmax(new_inter, 0), 1)
  new_seal  <- pmin(pmax(new_seal,  0), 1)
  
  # Update parameters
  params@interaction <- new_inter
  gear_params(params)$catchability[seal_idx] <- new_seal
  
  return(params)
}

```

Function to run multiple simulations with different interaction matrices
```{r}
# Function to run multiple simulations with different interaction matrices
run_random_sims <- function(params, n_sims = 10, years = 100, sd = 0.1,effort_scen) {
  # List to store simulation results
  sim_results <- list()
  
  # Run simulations
  for(i in 1:n_sims) {
    # Create new parameters with randomized interaction matrix
    rand_params <- randomize_interaction_matrix(params, sd = sd)
    # Run to steady
    rand_params<-steady(rand_params)
    # Run simulation
    sim <- project(rand_params, effort=effort_scen)
    
    # Store results
    sim_results[[i]] <- sim
  }
  
  return(sim_results)
}

```

```{r}
rand_params <- randomize_interaction_matrix(params)
sim1 <- project(rand_params,effort = effort)
plot(sim1,time_range=c(1978:2024))
plotBiomassRelative(sim1,sim0)
```

Figures - make plot of obs and sims
```{r}
# read in biomass and catches data
biomass_ts<-readRDS("Ess_data/biomass_ts.RDS")
biomass_ts<-biomass_ts |> rename(Biomass_Obs=Biomass) 
# -- Extract biomass time series from simulation lists for scenario 1 and 2 --
# sims_scen1 and sims_scen2: lists of simulation results, each with 1000 runs

sim_bio <- lapply(sims_scen1, getBiomass, min_w = species_params(params)$biomass_cutoff)
sim_bio2 <- lapply(sims_scen2, getBiomass, min_w = species_params(params)$biomass_cutoff)

# Combine the biomass data frames into one data frame for each scenario
df_sim_bio <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, sim_bio)
df_sim_bio$sim <- rep(1:1000, each = 47)        # Add simulation run index (1000 sims, 41 years each)
df_sim_bio$year <- rep(1978:2024, 1000)         # Add corresponding year for each row

df_sim_bio2 <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, sim_bio2)
df_sim_bio2$sim <- rep(1:1000, each = 47)
df_sim_bio2$year <- rep(1978:2024, 1000)

# -- Summarize simulation results by species and year for Scenario 1 --

sim_mean <- df_sim_bio |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19) |>
  mutate(Year = year, Species = factor(name, levels = names(df_sim_bio)[1:19])) |>
  group_by(Species, Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = median(value), .groups = "drop")

sim_lower <- df_sim_bio |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19) |>
  mutate(Year = year, Species = factor(name, levels = names(df_sim_bio)[1:19])) |>
  group_by(Species, Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = min(value), .groups = "drop")

sim_upper <- df_sim_bio |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19) |>
  mutate(Year = year, Species = factor(name, levels = names(df_sim_bio)[1:19])) |>
  group_by(Species, Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = max(value), .groups = "drop")


# -- Summarize simulation results by species and year for Scenario 2 (same process) --

sim_mean2 <- df_sim_bio2 |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19) |>
  mutate(Year = year, Species = factor(name, levels = names(df_sim_bio2)[1:19])) |>
  group_by(Species, Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = median(value), .groups = "drop")

sim_lower2 <- df_sim_bio2 |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19) |>
  mutate(Year = year, Species = factor(name, levels = names(df_sim_bio2)[1:19])) |>
  group_by(Species, Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = min(value), .groups = "drop")

sim_upper2 <- df_sim_bio2 |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19) |>
  mutate(Year = year, Species = factor(name, levels = names(df_sim_bio2)[1:19])) |>
  group_by(Species, Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = max(value), .groups = "drop")


# -- Create data frames with median, lower and upper quantiles for Scenario 1 --

sim1 <- data.frame(
  Species = sim_mean$Species,
  Year = sim_mean$Year,
  sim_mean = sim_mean$Biomass,
  sim_lower = sim_lower$Biomass,
  sim_upper = sim_upper$Biomass,

# Join observed biomass time series with simulation summaries for Scenario 1

# -- Same for Scenario 2 --

  Year = sim_mean2$Year,
  sim_mean = sim_mean2$Biomass,
  sim_lower = sim_lower2$Biomass,

sim2 <- left_join(biomass_ts, sim2)

# -- Combine both scenarios into one data frame for plotting or analysis --

time_series <- rbind(sim1, sim2)

# Rename observed biomass column to 'Biomass' for easier plotting

# -- Add a 'Calibration' label for years before 1986, keep scenario label after --
```

```{r}

biomass_plot <- ggplot(time_series, aes(x = Year, y = Biomass, colour = Scenario, fill = Scenario)) +
```

Taylor plot and correlation plot
```{r}
library(openair)
time_series_first4 <- sim2[, 1:4]
colnames(time_series_first4) <- c("Year", "Species","Biomass_observed", "Biomass")
time_series_first4<- time_series_first4 %>%  filter(Year >= 1986, Year <= 2024)
modStats(time_series_first4,
         obs  = "Biomass_observed",
         mod  = "Biomass",
         type = "Species",
         rank = "Species")

taylor_data <- time_series_first4 %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(
    Biomass_observed_norm = Biomass_observed / mean(Biomass_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    Biomass_norm          = Biomass / mean(Biomass_observed, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Choose distinct colors for species

x = TaylorDiagram(
  taylor_data,
  obs       = "Biomass_observed_norm",
  mod       = "Biomass_norm",
  group     = "Species"
  # normalise = TRUE,       # keep actual SD values
  # pch       = 12,
  # cex       = 1.2,
  # #col       = rainbow(length(unique(taylor_data$Species))),
  # pos.cor   = TRUE,
  # cor.range = c(-1, 1),    # allow negative correlations
  # main      = "Taylor Diagram – Model vs Observed Biomass by Species"
)


# Correlation plot by Species
ggplot(time_series_first4, aes(x = Biomass_observed, y = Biomass)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Species), size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(aes(label = paste(..r.label.., sep = "~`,`~")), 
           method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = 0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs( x = "Observed Biomass", y = "Model Biomass", title = "Observed vs Modeled Biomass by Species")

```


Figure for CATCHES 
```{r}
# read in observed catch data

yield_ts <- readRDS("Ess_data/yield_ts.RDS")

yield_ts <- yield_ts |> rename(Yield_Obs = Yield) |>
  filter(!Species %in% c("Sand Lance", "Capelin")) |>
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = unique(Species))) |>
  arrange(match(Species, levels(Species)), Year)

# ============================================================
# Function to extract catches from a simulation
# ============================================================

trimYield <- function(sim) {
  plotYieldGear(sim, return_data = TRUE) |>
    filter(Gear != "Seals") |>
    select(Year, Species, Yield)
}

# ============================================================
# Extract catches from all simulations
# ============================================================
sim_catches  <- lapply(sims_scen1, trimYield)
sim_catches2 <- lapply(sims_scen2, trimYield)

# Add simulation IDs
for (i in seq_along(sim_catches)) {
  sim_catches[[i]]$sim <- i
}

for (i in seq_along(sim_catches2)) {
  sim_catches2[[i]]$sim <- i
}

# ============================================================
# Combine simulation outputs
# ============================================================

df_sim_catch  <- do.call(rbind, sim_catches)
df_sim_catch2 <- do.call(rbind, sim_catches2)

# ============================================================
# Scenario 1 summaries
# ============================================================

sim_mean_c  <- df_sim_catch |> group_by(Species, Year) |> summarise(Yield = median(Yield), .groups = "drop")
sim_lower_c <- df_sim_catch |> group_by(Species, Year) |> summarise(Yield = min(Yield), .groups = "drop")
sim_upper_c <- df_sim_catch |> group_by(Species, Year) |> summarise(Yield = max(Yield), .groups = "drop")

# ============================================================
# Scenario 2 summaries
# ============================================================

sim_mean2_c  <- df_sim_catch2 |> group_by(Species, Year) |> summarise(Yield = median(Yield), .groups = "drop")
sim_lower2_c <- df_sim_catch2 |> group_by(Species, Year) |> summarise(Yield = min(Yield), .groups = "drop")
sim_upper2_c <- df_sim_catch2 |> group_by(Species, Year) |> summarise(Yield = max(Yield), .groups = "drop")

# ============================================================
# Create scenario data frames
# ============================================================

sim1_c <- data.frame(
  Species   = sim_mean_c$Species,
  Year      = sim_mean_c$Year, sim_mean  = sim_mean_c$Yield,
  sim_lower = sim_lower_c$Yield, sim_upper = sim_upper_c$Yield,
  scen      = "Scen1")

sim1_c <- right_join(yield_ts, sim1_c, by = c("Species", "Year"))

sim2_c <- data.frame(
  Species   = sim_mean2_c$Species,
  Year      = sim_mean2_c$Year, sim_mean  = sim_mean2_c$Yield,
  sim_lower = sim_lower2_c$Yield, sim_upper = sim_upper2_c$Yield,
  scen      = "Scen2")

sim2_c <- right_join(yield_ts, sim2_c, by = c("Species", "Year"))

# ============================================================
# Combine scenarios
time_series_c <- rbind(sim1_c, sim2_c)
time_series_c <- time_series_c |> mutate(scen = ifelse(Year < 1986, "Calibration", scen)) |> rename(Yield = Yield_Obs)

```

 Comparison of Model Skill Metrics across Model Scenarios
```{r}
# Calculate modStats
library(openair)
# Add log-transformed variables for catch (Yield)
time_series_c <- time_series_c |> mutate(logYield = log(Yield),logMeanSimYield=log(sim_mean))

first_group <- time_series_c %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  .[[1]]

 modStats_c = modStats(first_group, obs = "logYield", mod = "logMeanSimYield", type = "scen",rank = "scen",
  statistic = c("n", "FAC2", "MGE", "RMSE", "r", "COE"),method = "spearman")
# Compute performance statistics for each 'scen' group (Scenarios and Calibration period)
time_series <- time_series %>% rename( scen = Scenario )
time_series <- time_series |> mutate(logBiomass = log(Biomass),logMeanSimBiomass=log(sim_mean))

modStats <- time_series %>%
  group_modify(~modStats(.x, obs = "logBiomass", mod = "logMeanSimBiomass", type = "scen", rank = "Scenario",statistic=c("n","FAC2","MGE","RMSE","r","COE"),method="spearman")) %>%
  ungroup()


## Load flextable for formatted tables
library(flextable)
# Compute performance statistics for biomass data
tabl_b <-  modStats %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  select(c("scen","n","FAC2","MGE","RMSE","r","COE"))%>%
  flextable()
# Compute performance statistics for catch data
tabl_c <- modStats_c %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  select(c("scen","n","FAC2","MGE","RMSE","r","COE"))%>%
  flextable()

```


# Compare size-based trophic cascades under each scenario relative to histrorical when cod were abundant across species
```{r}
# Extract reference spectra from historical period (1970–1985) when cod were abundant
spectra_reference <- plotSpectra(sims_scen1[[1]], return_data = TRUE, time_range = 1978:1985)

# Extract spectra for Scenario 1 (without additional predation mortality) for 1995–2010
spectra_scen1 <- plotSpectra(sims_scen1[[1]], return_data = TRUE, time_range = 1995:2024)

# Extract spectra for Scenario 2 (with additional predation mortality) for 1995–2010
spectra_scen2 <- plotSpectra(sims_scen2[[1]], return_data = TRUE, time_range = 1995:2024)

# Join Scenario 1 spectra with reference and calculate symmetric relative difference
sf1 <- mutate(
  left_join(spectra_reference, spectra_scen1, by = c("w", "Legend")), 
  rel_diff = (value.y - value.x) / (value.x + value.y))

# Join Scenario 2 spectra with reference and calculate symmetric relative difference
sf2 <- mutate(
  left_join(spectra_reference, spectra_scen2, by = c("w", "Legend")), 
  rel_diff = (value.y - value.x) / (value.x + value.y))

# Add scenario labels for plotting
sf1$scenario <- "Fishing without additional predation mortality"
sf2$scenario <- "Fishing with additional predation mortality"

# Combine both scenarios into one data frame
combined_data <- rbind(sf1, sf2)

# Define manual colors for the scenarios
linecolours <- c("#D73027", "#4575B4")

# Set factor levels for consistent facet ordering
combined_data$Legend <- factor(combined_data$Legend, 
  levels = c("Resource", "Atlantic Cod", "Haddock", "White Hake", "Red Hake", "Silver Hake",
                    "Pollock", "Redfish Unseparated","American Plaice", "Yellowtail Flounder",
                    "Witch Flounder", "Atlantic Herring","Capelin", "Thorny Skate", 
                    "Winter Skate", "Spiny Dogfish", "Monkfish", "Sand Lance",
                    "Longhorn Sculpin",  "Atlantic Halibut"))

# Create the trophic cascade plot
trophic_cascades_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = w, y = rel_diff, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +  # Plot relative difference over weight
  facet_wrap(~Legend, scales = "free") +  # Separate panels by species
  labs(x = "Weight (g)", y = "Symmetric relative difference") +
  scale_x_log10() +  # Log scale for weight axis
  scale_color_manual(values = linecolours) +  # Apply manual colors to scenarios
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 1, colour = "dark grey", linewidth = 0.75) +  # Reference line at 0
  theme_bw() +  # Base theme
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank() 
  )

# Save the plot to file
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(save_dir, "trophic_cascades_plot.jpeg"),
  plot = trophic_cascades_plot, width = 11, height = 7.5, units = "in", dpi = 400)

# Print the plot to the output
trophic_cascades_plot
```

Spectra_community
```{r}
# Size spectra of the observed 
bio_size_read <- read.csv("Ess_data/bio_size.csv")
biomass_size_spectra<-bio_size %>% group_by(weightclass,Year)%>% summarise(nbiomass=sum(norm_biomass))%>%
  ungroup() 
#Observed Reference period 1970-1985
mean_biomass_size_spectra_ref <- biomass_size_spectra  %>% 
  filter(Year<1986) %>% group_by(weightclass) %>% 
  summarise(mean_nbiomass=mean(nbiomass))
#Observed Post Reference period 1986-2010
mean_biomass_size_spectra_post <- biomass_size_spectra  %>% 
  filter(Year>1985) %>% group_by(weightclass) %>% 
  summarise(mean_nbiomass=mean(nbiomass))
# create function to calculate *community* size spectrum from a time period.
sizespec<-function(sim,time_range){
  ssdf<-plotSpectra(sim, power = 0,  resource = F, return_data = TRUE, time_range = time_range) |>
    group_by(w)|>
    summarise(sum(value)) 
    #|>filter(w >= 0.001)
  return(ssdf)
}

ssdf_ref <-lapply(sims_scen1, sizespec,  time_range = 1978:1985)
ssdf1 <- lapply(sims_scen1, sizespec,  time_range = 1995:2020)
ssdf2 <- lapply(sims_scen2, sizespec, time_range = 1995:2020)

# Add simulation ID to each element in the list
iter = 1000 # should be 1000 in you dataset?
for (i in 1:iter) {
  ssdf_ref[[i]]$sim <- i
  ssdf1[[i]]$sim <- i
  ssdf2[[i]]$sim <- i
}

# Combine all the size spectra sims dataframes into one data frame for each scenario
df_ssdf_ref <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, ssdf_ref)
# Combine all the size spectra sims dataframes into one data frame for each scenario
df_ssdf_1 <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, ssdf1)
# Combine all the size spectra sims dataframes into one data frame for each scenario
df_ssdf_2 <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, ssdf2)

# Compute summary statistics (median, min, max) for each species and year in REFERENCE
df_ssdf_ref_mean  <- df_ssdf_ref |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = median(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()
df_ssdf_ref_lower <- df_ssdf_ref |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = min(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()
df_ssdf_ref_upper <- df_ssdf_ref |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = max(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()

# Compute summary statistics for Scenario 1
sim_mean1_ssdf  <- df_ssdf_1 |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = median(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()
sim_lower1_ssdf <- df_ssdf_1 |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = min(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()
sim_upper1_ssdf <- df_ssdf_1 |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = max(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()

# Compute summary statistics for Scenario 2
sim_mean2_ssdf  <- df_ssdf_2 |>group_by(w) |> summarise(N = median(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()
sim_lower2_ssdf <- df_ssdf_2 |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = min(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()
sim_upper2_ssdf <- df_ssdf_2 |> group_by(w) |> summarise(N = max(`sum(value)`)) |> ungroup()

# Create summary dataframe for REFERENCE and join with observed yield time series
ss_c_ref <- data.frame(
  w   = df_ssdf_ref_mean$w, 
  sim_meanN      = df_ssdf_ref_mean$N,
  sim_lowerN  = df_ssdf_ref_lower$N,
  sim_upperN = df_ssdf_ref_upper$N,
  scen      = rep("REF", length(df_ssdf_ref_mean$w)))

# Create summary dataframe for Scenario 1 and join with observed yield time series
ss_c_1 <- data.frame(
  w   = sim_mean1_ssdf$w, 
  sim_meanN      = sim_mean1_ssdf$N,
  sim_lowerN  = sim_lower1_ssdf$N,
  sim_upperN = sim_upper1_ssdf$N,
  scen      = rep("Scen1", length(sim_mean1_ssdf$w)))

# Create summary dataframe for Scenario 2
ss_c_2 <- data.frame(
  w = sim_mean2_ssdf$w, sim_meanN  = sim_mean2_ssdf$N,
  sim_lowerN = sim_lower2_ssdf$N,sim_upperN = sim_upper2_ssdf$N,
  scen  = rep("Scen2", length(sim_mean2_ssdf$w)))

# Combine all scenarios
time_series_c <- rbind(ss_c_1, ss_c_2, ss_c_ref)

# ---------------------------------------------
# 2. Recode scenario names
# ---------------------------------------------
time_series_c <- time_series_c %>%
  mutate(scen = recode(scen,
      "Scen1" = "Fishing without additional mortality",  # Fixed: Capital S
      "Scen2" = "Fishing with additional mortality",     # Fixed: Capital S
      "REF"   = "Reference period") )

# Define line colours
linecolours <- c(
  "Fishing without additional mortality" = "#4575B4",
  "Fishing with additional mortality"    = "#D73027",
  "Reference period"                     = "darkgray")

# Create the spectra plot
# Define y-axis limits for annotation
y_limits <- range(time_series_c$sim_meanN, na.rm = TRUE)
x_limits <- range(time_series_c$w, na.rm = TRUE)

spectra_plot <- ggplot( time_series_c, aes(x = w, y = sim_meanN, colour = scen, fill = scen)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lowerN, ymax = sim_upperN), alpha = 0.1, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = mean_biomass_size_spectra_ref,  aes(x = weightclass, y = mean_nbiomass), inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.8, shape = 23, fill = "white", colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = mean_biomass_size_spectra_post, aes(x = weightclass, y = mean_nbiomass),  inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.8, shape = 23, fill = "black", colour = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = linecolours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = linecolours) +
  labs(x = "Size (g)", y = "Normalized biomass density") +
  annotate("text",
           x = x_limits[1] * 0.8,  # slightly left of min x
           y = y_limits[2] * 0.95, # near top
           label = "(a)",
           hjust = 0,
           vjust = 1.2,
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 6) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Arial"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1.5)
  )
```

 Relative difference spectra of Sceanrio 1 and 2 with reference

```{r}
library(ggtext)
# Join Scenario 1 spectra with reference and calculate symmetric relative difference
sf1 <- left_join(ss_c_ref, ss_c_1,by = "w") %>%
  mutate(rel_diff = (sim_meanN.y - sim_meanN.x) / (sim_meanN.x + sim_meanN.y))

# Join Scenario 2 spectra with reference and calculate symmetric relative difference
sf2 <- left_join(ss_c_ref, ss_c_2,by = "w") %>%
  mutate(rel_diff = (sim_meanN.y - sim_meanN.x) / (sim_meanN.x + sim_meanN.y))
# -----------------------------
# 2. Add scenario labels
# -----------------------------
ss_c_ref <- ss_c_ref %>%mutate(scenario = "Reference period")
ss_c_1 <- ss_c_1 %>%mutate(scenario = "Fishing without additional predation mortality")
ss_c_2 <- ss_c_2 %>%mutate(scenario = "Fishing with additional predation mortality")

# -----------------------------
# 3. Ensure consistent column names
# -----------------------------
# Rename numeric columns to a common base name for relative difference calculation
ss_c_ref <- ss_c_ref %>%rename(value = sim_meanN)
ss_c_1 <- ss_c_1 %>%rename(value = sim_meanN)
ss_c_2 <- ss_c_2 %>% rename(value = sim_meanN)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Compute relative differences between reference and each scenario
# -----------------------------
sf1 <- ss_c_ref %>%left_join(ss_c_1, by = "w", suffix = c(".ref", ".scen1")) %>%
  mutate(rel_diff = (value.scen1 - value.ref) / (value.scen1 + value.ref),
         scenario = "Fishing without additional predation mortality")

sf2 <- ss_c_ref %>%left_join(ss_c_2, by = "w", suffix = c(".ref", ".scen2")) %>%
  mutate(rel_diff = (value.scen2 - value.ref) / (value.scen2 + value.ref),
         scenario = "Fishing with additional predation mortality")

# 5. Combine both scenarios
# -----------------------------
combined_data <- bind_rows(sf1, sf2)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Define manual colors for the scenarios
# -----------------------------
linecolours <- c(
  "Fishing without additional predation mortality" = "#4575B4",
  "Fishing with additional predation mortality" = "#D73027")

# -----------------------------
# 7. Plot
# Define y-axis limits for annotation (you can also use ggplot_build to get them dynamically)
y_limits <- range(combined_data$rel_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

Relative_trophic_plot <-  ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = w, y = rel_diff, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) + labs(x = "Weight (g)", y = "Symmetric relative difference") +
  scale_x_log10(  breaks = c(1e-1, 1e2, 1e5),labels = c("**1e-1**", "**10e+2**", "**1e+5**")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = linecolours) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.75) +
  annotate( "text", x = min(combined_data$w) * 0.2, y = max(y_limits) * 0.95,label = "(b)",
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,fontface = "bold",size = 6) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 10),  # <- bold x-axis labels
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

Relative_trophic_plot
spectra = spectra_plot/Relative_trophic_plot #bind plots

ggsave(filename = paste0(save_dir, "spectra_plot.jpeg"), plot = spectra, width = 11, height = 7.5, units = "in", dpi =400)
```
